We also study the convergence rate of hybrid FPA-based strategies, which is an important aspect of any hybridization endeavor. To evaluate the convergence rate of the hybrid variants of FPA, they are executed 20 times with different iteration values (i.e., 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 100, 200, 300, 500, and 1000). The average values of the 20 runs for the two well-known CAs, CA (N; 2, 105) and CA (N; 2, 46), are used to demonstrate the convergence speed of the proposed algorithms.
